summary.zh: 内测通道体验打磨：设置里的通道区更名为「内测通道」并精简了多余说明；新增「检查平台更新」按钮，可以随时手动检查并获取最新内测版本，不再只依赖自动检查。
summary.en: Beta channel polish: the channel section in Settings is renamed to “beta channel” with redundant copy removed, and a new “check for platform updates” button lets you manually check for the latest beta build at any time instead of relying only on automatic checks.

title.zh: 内测通道新增「检查平台更新」按钮
title.en: Manual platform-update check arrives in the beta channel section

summary.zh: 加入内测通道后，可随时点击「检查」立即查询最新内测版本，按钮旁实时显示检查中/发现新版/已就绪等状态。
summary.en: Once on the beta channel, click Check to query the latest beta build immediately; live status (checking / available / ready) shows beside the button.

details.zh: 此前平台更新只有自动触发（启动时与定时检查），没有手动入口。
details.en: Previously the platform update had only automatic triggers (at startup and on a timer) with no manual entry point.

sources.title: feat(updater): beta-channel section cleanup and a manual platform-update check

title.zh: 通道区更名与文案精简
title.en: Channel section renamed and copy tightened

summary.zh: 「测试通道」更名为「内测通道」，与旁边的「接收测试版更新」开关区分开；删去两条重复说明文字。
summary.en: “Test channel” becomes “beta channel,” distinguishing it from the neighbouring “receive test updates” toggle; two redundant explainer lines are removed.
